name: uml_repo_bundle
description: Generate a multi-scope UML bundle for the whole repository with overview and major-scope slices.

inputs.output_dir: Optional output directory. Defaults to Docs/uml/repo_bundle.
inputs.include_tests: Whether test files should be included in the scan. Defaults to false.
inputs.max_directory_bundles: How many top directories should get their own slice diagrams. Defaults to 6.

outputs.bundle_index: Markdown index for the repository UML bundle.
outputs.bundle_summary: JSON summary with top directories and generated assets.
outputs.diagrams: Repository overview and directory slice diagrams.
